Name: CP - HD Portrait - 3D Anime - Juliet and Jessie
Author: Gizzlembos03
Description:
This is my take on Juliet. I tried to stay as loyal at the original as possible. All 12 Juliet outfits (seasons + festivities) included.

Uses Content patcher and HD Portraits.

-- Install --

1. You need this mods and all its requirements

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6398]Juliet and Jessie the Joja Clerks[/url]

2. Download the mod and put the folder inside the zip in the mods folder. No need to replace anything.




-- Credits --

All credits to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657]lemurkat[/url] for creating Juliet and Jessie, giving me permission to do this and helping me.
